children: August delivered plenty of fireworks for oil traders, but little in the way of a lasting move.

Brent crude futures swung in a wide range this month as investors navigated shifting headlines around growing tensions-and then possible diplomatic progress-in the Middle East. But on a month-to-date basis, prices aren't too far off from where they began.

Brent's currently up almost 4% this month-a relatively small move in this current environment. In fact, it's the smallest monthly move posted in either direction for Brent since December of last year.
That doesn't mean volatility in energy prices is subsiding. Brent prices are surging this morning after U.S. forces targeted Iran for the first time in weeks.
